skills.name: Negate Poison
skills.desc:
Weakens the effects of
Deadly Poison and completely
prevents lesser Poisons.
skills.brief: Stops the two milder strengths of poison (including a Toadstool's) and turns Deadly Poison into the middle strength: 3 HP per second instead of 5. Poisonous ground no longer tops your poison up.

skills.name: Double Poison
skills.desc:
Doubles the damage received
from Poison.
skills.brief: Each poison tick takes twice the health (Deadly Poison: 10 HP per second); how long poison lasts is unchanged. Wellness or a Pyroscale Talisman cancels it.

skills.name: Negate Paralysis
skills.desc: Prevents Paralysis.
skills.brief: Blocks paralysis completely, from monster attacks and from a bad Exciteshroom, so a paralysing hit becomes an ordinary hit.

skills.name: Double Paralysis
skills.desc:
Doubles the duration of
Paralysis.
skills.brief: Paralysis lasts twice as long: 8.67 s instead of 4.33 s. Mashing buttons still shortens it, but there is twice as much to get through.

skills.name: Negate Sleep
skills.desc: Prevents Sleep.
skills.brief: Sleep hits from monsters build up nothing, so you never fall asleep; sleep attacks become ordinary hits.

skills.name: Double Sleep
skills.desc:
Doubles the duration of
Sleep.
skills.brief: Sleep lasts 16 s instead of 8 s. How quickly sleep builds up is unchanged.

skills.name: Negate Stun
skills.desc: Prevents Stun.
skills.brief: Stunning hits never build up toward a stun, so you are never stunned. Halve Stun adds nothing on top.

skills.name: Halve Stun
skills.desc:
Reduces the likelihood of
being Stunned by 50%.
skills.brief: Each time stun build-up is full, there is a 1 in 2 chance you are not stunned and the build-up resets to 0. Does nothing alongside Negate Stun.

skills.name: Double Stun
skills.desc:
Makes it harder to recover
from being Stunned.
skills.brief: Mashing out of a stun takes twice the inputs (74 instead of 37). Each stage still ends on its own after 12.5 s, and you are not stunned more often.

skills.name: HG Earplugs
skills.desc:
Negates the effects of all
large monsters' roars.
skills.brief: Blocks every monster roar, small and large grade, so you never cover your ears. Covers everything Earplugs does, and Alchemy Earplugs are never used up.

skills.name: Earplugs
skills.desc:
Negates the effects of some
large monsters' roars.
skills.brief: Blocks only the small grade of monster roars; large roars still make you cover your ears and need HG Earplugs.

skills.name: Windproof (Hi)
skills.desc:
Negates Wind Pressure from
almost all monsters.
skills.brief: Blocks small and large wind pressure. The strongest grade still affects you, but only with the milder large-wind reaction.

skills.name: Windproof (Lo)
skills.desc: Lessens almost all Wind Pressure.
skills.brief: Blocks only the small grades of wind pressure; large and strongest wind pressure affect you exactly as without the skill.

skills.name: Tremor Res
skills.desc:
Prevents staggering from
tremors created by large
monsters.
skills.brief: Blocks both kinds of tremor reaction, so you no longer stagger when a large monster shakes the ground.

skills.name: Negate Bind
skills.desc:
Negates the effects of Bind
statuses such as Snowman and
bubbles that impede movement.
skills.brief: Bind attacks that would hold you for 4 s or 6 s become a plain hit, bubbles never reach their second stage, and several other states that hold or restrict you are blocked.

skills.name: Heat Cancel
skills.desc:
Negates the damage incurred
from heat and lava.
skills.brief: Removes all health loss from heat, in hot areas and on hot ground, and red health keeps recovering on hot ground. Heat Surge has no effect alongside it.

skills.name: Heat Surge
skills.desc:
Increases the amount of
Health lost due to heat.
skills.brief: Heat drains health twice as fast, in hot areas and on hot ground. No effect with Heat Cancel, Tropic Hunter or Steelshell Talisman; a Cool Drink cancels the hot-area part.

skills.name: Cold Cancel
skills.desc: Negates all cold.
skills.brief: Cold takes no health but makes maximum stamina shrink faster; this removes that extra speed, so a cold area costs no more stamina than a warm one. Cold Surge has no effect alongside it.

skills.name: Cold Surge
skills.desc:
Increases the speed at which
your maximum Stamina depletes
from cold.
skills.brief: In cold areas maximum stamina shrinks much faster (the cold part is doubled), so you must eat more often. No effect with Cold Cancel, Polar Hunter, Hazefur Talisman or a Hot Drink.

skills.name: Polar Hunter
skills.desc:
Powers you up in the cold.
If you drink a Cool Drink...
skills.brief: In cold areas: +15 attack, +20 defense and no cold stamina loss (as Cold Cancel). While a Cool Drink is in effect: +5 attack anywhere.

skills.name: Tropic Hunter
skills.desc:
Powers you up in the heat.
If you drink a Hot Drink...
skills.brief: In hot areas: +15 attack, +20 defense and no heat health loss (as Heat Cancel). While a Hot Drink is in effect: +10 defense anywhere.

skills.name: Anti-Theft
skills.desc: Prevents item theft.
skills.brief: Monsters can never steal your items, so you never have to chase a thief to get them back.

skills.name: Iron Skin
skills.desc:
Negates the effects of
Defense Down.
skills.brief: Blocks both Defense Down effects from monster attacks: the lesser (defense x0.8) and the greater (x0.5), each normally lasting 3 min.

skills.name: Antivirus
skills.desc:
Makes it harder to
become Frenzied and
enhances recovery.
skills.brief: Each hit does more to overcome the Frenzy virus (+5 progress, so small hits count double), and overcoming it gives +30% affinity instead of +15%. It does not make infection less likely.

skills.name: Bio Master
skills.desc:
Increases Dung Bomb efficacy,
prevents Stench and Blastblight,
and delays Virus onset.
skills.brief: Everything Bio Researcher does (blocks Stench and Blastblight; dung projectiles carry 180 dung value instead of 100), and a full Frenzy infection ends after 48 s instead of 60 s.

skills.name: Bio Researcher
skills.desc:
Increases Dung Bomb efficacy,
and prevents Stench
and Blastblight.
skills.brief: Blocks Stench and Blastblight, including the Stench from a bad Exciteshroom, and dung projectiles carry 180 dung value instead of 100.

skills.name: Negate Bleeding
skills.desc: Prevents Bleeding.
skills.brief: Bleeding hits build up nothing, so you never start bleeding (normally 2 HP lost each second); bleeding attacks become ordinary hits.

skills.name: Double Bleeding
skills.desc:
Doubles the damage received
from Bleeding.
skills.brief: Bleeding takes 4 HP each second instead of 2. The build-up and how long bleeding lasts are unchanged.

skills.name: Attack Up (L)
skills.desc: Greatly increases Attack.
skills.brief: +20 attack, added before every multiplier, so Fortify, Adrenaline +2, Dragonheart and the rest multiply it too. Only one Attack skill applies.

skills.name: Attack Up (M)
skills.desc: Increases Attack.
skills.brief: +15 attack, added before every multiplier, so Fortify, Adrenaline +2, Dragonheart and the rest multiply it too. Only one Attack skill applies.

skills.name: Attack Up (S)
skills.desc: Slightly increases Attack.
skills.brief: +10 attack, added before every multiplier, so Fortify, Adrenaline +2, Dragonheart and the rest multiply it too. Only one Attack skill applies.

skills.name: Attack Down (S)
skills.desc: Slightly decreases Attack.
skills.brief: -5 attack, taken off before every multiplier, so the loss grows with Fortify, Adrenaline +2 and the rest. Only one Attack skill applies.

skills.name: Attack Down (M)
skills.desc: Decreases Attack.
skills.brief: -10 attack, taken off before every multiplier, so the loss grows with Fortify, Adrenaline +2 and the rest. Only one Attack skill applies.

skills.name: Attack Down (L)
skills.desc: Greatly decreases Attack.
skills.brief: -15 attack, taken off before every multiplier, so the loss grows with Fortify, Adrenaline +2 and the rest. Only one Attack skill applies.

skills.name: Defense Up (L)
skills.desc: Greatly increases Defense.
skills.brief: Base defense x1.06, then +25 (base 300: 344 instead of 301), applied before Fortify and every other bonus. The percentage part grows with your base defense.

skills.name: Defense Up (M)
skills.desc: Increases Defense.
skills.brief: Base defense x1.03, then +20 (base 300: 330 instead of 301), applied before Fortify and every other bonus. The percentage part grows with your base defense.

skills.name: Defense Up (S)
skills.desc: Slightly increases Defense.
skills.brief: +15 defense (base 300: 316 instead of 301), the same at every base defense, applied before Fortify and every other bonus.

skills.name: Defense Down (S)
skills.desc: Slightly decreases Defense.
skills.brief: -10 defense (base 300: 291 instead of 301), the same at every base defense, applied before Fortify and every other bonus.

skills.name: Defense Down (M)
skills.desc: Decreases Defense.
skills.brief: Base defense x0.95, then -10 (base 300: 276 instead of 301), applied before Fortify and every other bonus. The loss grows with your base defense.

skills.name: Defense Down (L)
skills.desc: Greatly decreases Defense.
skills.brief: Base defense x0.9, then -10 (base 300: 261 instead of 301), applied before Fortify and every other bonus. The loss grows with your base defense.

skills.name: Health +50
skills.desc: Increases maximum Health by 50.
skills.brief: Maximum health 150 instead of 100. That is already the 150 cap, so any other health bonus is wasted.

skills.name: Health +20
skills.desc: Increases maximum Health by 20.
skills.brief: Maximum health 120 instead of 100. Other health bonuses add on top, up to the 150 cap.

skills.name: Health -10
skills.desc: Decreases maximum Health by 10.
skills.brief: Maximum health 90 instead of 100. Other health bonuses still add on top.

skills.name: Health -30
skills.desc: Decreases maximum Health by 30.
skills.brief: Maximum health 70 instead of 100, so hits that would leave you at low health can cart you.

skills.name: Fire Res +20
skills.desc: Increases Fire Resistance by 20.
skills.brief: +20 Fire resistance: Fire attacks do 20% less damage, and reaching 15 resistance makes Fireblight milder, 25 prevents it. Only one Fire Res skill applies.

skills.name: Fire Res +15
skills.desc: Increases Fire Resistance by 15.
skills.brief: +15 Fire resistance: Fire attacks do 15% less damage, and reaching 15 resistance makes Fireblight milder, 25 prevents it. Only one Fire Res skill applies.

skills.name: Fire Res -20
skills.desc: Decreases Fire Resistance by 20.
skills.brief: -20 Fire resistance: Fire attacks do 20% more damage, and Fireblight is harder to avoid (below 15 resistance, most Fire attacks give the stronger blight).

skills.name: Water Res +20
skills.desc: Increases Water Resistance by 20.
skills.brief: +20 Water resistance: Water attacks do 20% less damage, and reaching 15 resistance makes Waterblight milder, 25 prevents it. Only one Water Res skill applies.

skills.name: Water Res +15
skills.desc: Increases Water Resistance by 15.
skills.brief: +15 Water resistance: Water attacks do 15% less damage, and reaching 15 resistance makes Waterblight milder, 25 prevents it. Only one Water Res skill applies.

skills.name: Water Res -20
skills.desc: Decreases Water Resistance by 20.
skills.brief: -20 Water resistance: Water attacks do 20% more damage, and Waterblight is harder to avoid (below 15 resistance, most Water attacks give the stronger blight).

skills.name: Thunder Res +20
skills.desc: Increases Thunder Resistance by 20.
skills.brief: +20 Thunder resistance: Thunder attacks do 20% less damage, and reaching 15 resistance makes Thunderblight milder, 25 prevents it. Only one Thunder Res skill applies.

skills.name: Thunder Res +15
skills.desc: Increases Thunder Resistance by 15.
skills.brief: +15 Thunder resistance: Thunder attacks do 15% less damage, and reaching 15 resistance makes Thunderblight milder, 25 prevents it. Only one Thunder Res skill applies.

skills.name: Thunder Res -20
skills.desc: Decreases Thunder Resistance by 20.
skills.brief: -20 Thunder resistance: Thunder attacks do 20% more damage, and Thunderblight is harder to avoid (below 15 resistance, most Thunder attacks give the stronger blight).

skills.name: Ice Res +20
skills.desc: Increases Ice Resistance by 20.
skills.brief: +20 Ice resistance: Ice attacks do 20% less damage, and reaching 15 resistance makes Iceblight (also from icy ground) milder, 25 prevents it. Only one Ice Res skill applies.

skills.name: Ice Res +15
skills.desc: Increases Ice Resistance by 15.
skills.brief: +15 Ice resistance: Ice attacks do 15% less damage, and reaching 15 resistance makes Iceblight (also from icy ground) milder, 25 prevents it. Only one Ice Res skill applies.

skills.name: Ice Res -20
skills.desc: Decreases Ice Resistance by 20.
skills.brief: -20 Ice resistance: Ice attacks do 20% more damage, and Iceblight is harder to avoid (below 15 resistance, most Ice attacks give the stronger blight).

skills.name: Dragon Res +20
skills.desc: Increases Dragon Resistance by 20.
skills.brief: +20 Dragon resistance: Dragon attacks do 20% less damage, and reaching 15 resistance makes Dragonblight milder, 25 prevents it. Only one Dragon Res skill applies.

skills.name: Dragon Res +15
skills.desc: Increases Dragon Resistance by 15.
skills.brief: +15 Dragon resistance: Dragon attacks do 15% less damage, and reaching 15 resistance makes Dragonblight milder, 25 prevents it. Only one Dragon Res skill applies.

skills.name: Dragon Res -20
skills.desc: Decreases Dragon Resistance by 20.
skills.brief: -20 Dragon resistance: Dragon attacks do 20% more damage, and Dragonblight is harder to avoid (below 15 resistance, most Dragon attacks give the stronger blight).

skills.name: Blightproof
skills.desc:
Negates all elemental blights (Fire,
Water, Thunder, Ice, and Dragon).
skills.brief: Blocks all five elemental blights at both levels from monster attacks, and Iceblight from icy ground. It does not stop Blastblight or the Dragonblight that Dragonheart puts on you.

skills.name: Fire Atk +2
skills.desc:
Greatly increases the power
of Fire attacks and Flaming
shots (Flaming S).
skills.brief: Fire element x1.1, then +6, also on Fire shots (Flaming S) and Fire arrows. Element multipliers together are capped at x1.2, but the +6 is added after the cap.

skills.name: Fire Atk +1
skills.desc:
Increases the power of Fire
attacks and Flaming shots
(Flaming S).
skills.brief: Fire element x1.05, then +4, also on Fire shots (Flaming S) and Fire arrows. Stacks in full with Element Atk Up (x1.155, under the x1.2 cap).

skills.name: Fire Atk Down
skills.desc:
Decreases the power of Fire
attacks and Flaming shots
(Flaming S).
skills.brief: Fire element x0.75 with nothing added, also on Fire shots (Flaming S) and Fire arrows. Element Atk Up only softens it to x0.825.

skills.name: Water Atk +2
skills.desc:
Greatly increases the power
of Water attacks and Water
shots (Water S).
skills.brief: Water element x1.1, then +6, also on Water shots (Water S) and Water arrows. Element multipliers together are capped at x1.2, but the +6 is added after the cap.

skills.name: Water Atk +1
skills.desc:
Increases the power of Water
attacks and Water shots
(Water S).
skills.brief: Water element x1.05, then +4, also on Water shots (Water S) and Water arrows. Stacks in full with Element Atk Up (x1.155, under the x1.2 cap).

skills.name: Water Atk Down
skills.desc:
Decreases the power of Water
attacks and Water shots
(Water S).
skills.brief: Water element x0.75 with nothing added, also on Water shots (Water S) and Water arrows. Element Atk Up only softens it to x0.825.

skills.name: Thunder Atk +2
skills.desc:
Greatly increases the power
of Thunder attacks and
Thunder shots (Thunder S).
skills.brief: Thunder element x1.1, then +6, also on Thunder shots (Thunder S) and Thunder arrows. Element multipliers together are capped at x1.2, but the +6 is added after the cap.

skills.name: Thunder Atk +1
skills.desc:
Increases the power of
Thunder attacks and Thunder
shots (Thunder S).
skills.brief: Thunder element x1.05, then +4, also on Thunder shots (Thunder S) and Thunder arrows. Stacks in full with Element Atk Up (x1.155, under the x1.2 cap).

skills.name: Thunder Atk Down
skills.desc:
Decreases the power of
Thunder attacks and Thunder
shots (Thunder S).
skills.brief: Thunder element x0.75 with nothing added, also on Thunder shots (Thunder S) and Thunder arrows. Element Atk Up only softens it to x0.825.

skills.name: Ice Atk +2
skills.desc:
Greatly increases the power
of Ice attacks and Freeze
shots (Freeze S).
skills.brief: Ice element x1.1, then +6, also on Ice shots (Freeze S) and Ice arrows. Element multipliers together are capped at x1.2, but the +6 is added after the cap.

skills.name: Ice Atk +1
skills.desc:
Increases the power of Ice
attacks and Freeze shots
(Freeze S).
skills.brief: Ice element x1.05, then +4, also on Ice shots (Freeze S) and Ice arrows. Stacks in full with Element Atk Up (x1.155, under the x1.2 cap).

skills.name: Ice Atk Down
skills.desc:
Decreases the power of Ice
attacks and Freeze shots
(Freeze S).
skills.brief: Ice element x0.75 with nothing added, also on Ice shots (Freeze S) and Ice arrows. Element Atk Up only softens it to x0.825.

skills.name: Dragon Atk +2
skills.desc:
Greatly increases the power
of Dragon attacks and Dragon
shots (Dragon S).
skills.brief: Dragon element x1.1, then +6, also on Dragon shots (Dragon S), Dragon arrows and one Switch Axe phial path. Element multipliers together are capped at x1.2; the +6 is added after.

skills.name: Dragon Atk +1
skills.desc:
Increases the power of Dragon
attacks and Dragon shots
(Dragon S).
skills.brief: Dragon element x1.05, then +4, also on Dragon shots (Dragon S), Dragon arrows and one Switch Axe phial path. Stacks in full with Element Atk Up (x1.155, under the x1.2 cap).

skills.name: Dragon Atk Down
skills.desc:
Decreases the power of Dragon
attacks and Dragon shots
(Dragon S).
skills.brief: Dragon element x0.75 with nothing added, also on Dragon shots (Dragon S), Dragon arrows and one Switch Axe phial path. Element Atk Up only softens it to x0.825.

skills.name: Element Atk Up
skills.desc:
Increases the power of
elemental attacks.
skills.brief: All five elements x1.1, also on elemental shots, arrows and one Switch Axe phial path; status and Blast are untouched. Element multipliers together are capped at x1.2.

skills.name: Element Atk Down
skills.desc:
Decreases the power of
elemental attacks.
skills.brief: All five elements x0.9, also on elemental shots, arrows and one Switch Axe phial path. It does nothing if Element Atk Up or Elementality is also active.

skills.name: Status Atk +2
skills.desc:
Increases the potency of
abnormal status attacks.
skills.brief: Poison, paralysis and sleep buildup x1.2, then +1, on your weapon, shots, arrows, Bow coatings and Switch Axe status phials. With Felyne Specialist the total is capped at x1.25. Blast is not affected.

skills.name: Status Atk +1
skills.desc:
Slightly increases the potency
of abnormal status attacks.
skills.brief: Poison, paralysis and sleep buildup x1.1, then +1, on your weapon, shots, arrows, Bow coatings and Switch Axe status phials. Stacks almost in full with Felyne Specialist. Blast is not affected.

skills.name: Status Atk Down
skills.desc:
Decreases the potency of
abnormal status attacks.
skills.brief: Poison, paralysis and sleep buildup x0.9 with nothing added, on your weapon, shots, arrows, Bow coatings and Switch Axe status phials. Blast is not affected.

skills.name: Speed Sharpening
skills.desc: Speeds up weapon sharpening.
skills.brief: Sharpening takes one whetstone stroke instead of four: 1.97 s instead of 4.33 s, with the same amount restored. Gunners only benefit with Heavy Polish.

skills.name: Slow Sharpening
skills.desc: Slows down weapon sharpening.
skills.brief: Sharpening takes one extra stroke: 5.1 s instead of 4.33 s, with the same amount restored. Hellblade Soul and Hellblade Soul X override it.

skills.name: Sharpness +2
skills.desc:
Increases the length of your
weapon's Sharpness Gauge.
skills.brief: Raises the weapon's sharpness level by 2: up to +50 sharpness points (about 50 more normal hits), never past the 450 maximum. Does not add to Sharpness +1; no effect for gunners.

skills.name: Sharpness +1
skills.desc:
Slightly increases the length of
your weapon's Sharpness Gauge.
skills.brief: Raises the weapon's sharpness level by 1: up to +25 sharpness points (about 25 more normal hits), nothing on a weapon already at the top level. No effect for gunners.

skills.name: Razor Sharp
skills.desc:
Halves the rate at which your
weapon loses Sharpness.
skills.brief: Halves sharpness loss: a normal hit has a 50% chance to cost nothing and bigger losses are halved (never below 1), so sharpness lasts about twice as many hits. Switches off Blunt Edge.

skills.name: Blunt Edge
skills.desc:
Doubles the rate at which your
weapon loses Sharpness.
skills.brief: Doubles sharpness loss: a normal hit costs 2 points instead of 1, a deflected hit 4 instead of 2. Razor Sharp and the skills that count as it cancel it.

skills.name: Mind's Eye
skills.desc:
Prevents your attacks from
being deflected.
skills.brief: Hits that would bounce land as normal hits instead, costing normal sharpness; only a few attacks can still bounce. Works for Blademaster weapons and the Bow, not the Light or Heavy Bowgun.

skills.name: Blind Eye
skills.desc:
Causes your attacks to be
deflected more easily.
skills.brief: Hits that cut only moderately well bounce 1 time in 3, rolled once per attack; the best-cutting hits are never affected. Steady Hand, Nightcloak Soul and Nightcloak Soul X cancel it.

skills.name: Heavy Polish
skills.desc:
Use a whetstone to polish a
weapon and briefly increase
its strength.
skills.brief: Sharpening starts a 60 s polish: Blademasters lose no sharpness, and gunner shots with the x1.5 distance bonus get x1.75. It also lets Bow and Bowgun users sharpen with whetstones.

skills.name: Bludgeoner
skills.desc:
Increases Attack based on
how low the Sharpness of
your weapon is.
skills.brief: Attack x1.2 at red or orange sharpness, x1.15 at yellow, x1.1 at green, no change at blue or better. Blademasters only, and low sharpness still never beats blue.

skills.name: Critical Draw
skills.desc:
Increases Affinity for all
draw attacks by 100%.
skills.brief: +100 affinity on draw attacks, so with 0% or more affinity every draw attack is a critical hit. No effect at red sharpness; the Bow always gets it.

skills.name: Punishing Draw
skills.desc:
Can Stun monsters with draw
attacks from cutting weapons,
and slightly increases Attack.
skills.brief: Draw attacks can stun and exhaust monsters, and you get +5 attack before multipliers. Cutting weapons only: no effect for the Hammer, Hunting Horn, Bowguns or Bow.

skills.name: Quick Sheath
skills.desc: Increases weapon-sheathing speed.
skills.brief: Sheathing plays at x1.4 speed, about 29% faster, for every weapon (two shared sheathe actions excepted). Does not stack with Sheath Control or Rustrazor Soul.

skills.name: Challenge Sheath
skills.desc:
Sheathing when a monster is
enraged gives a chance to
sharpen your weapon.
skills.brief: Sheathing while an enraged large monster is in your area has a 35% chance to restore 4 to 16 sharpness, depending on the weapon (least for the Great Sword). No effect for gunners.

skills.name: Bladescale Hone
skills.desc:
Dodging while weapon is drawn will
have various special effects. Improves
C.Range Coating for bows.
skills.brief: Blademasters regain 5 sharpness (7 on some weapons) every few drawn-weapon dodges. Bowgun dodges have a 50% chance of a special effect; a Bow gains or improves Close-Range Coating.

skills.name: Reload Speed +3
skills.desc:
Greatly speeds up Bowgun
reloading, and auto-loads
Bow coatings.
skills.brief: Raises a Bowgun's reload rating by 3 steps, moving every ammo three steps toward the fast reload band, and a Bow loads a coating the moment you select it.

skills.name: Reload Speed +2
skills.desc:
Speeds up Bowgun reloading,
and auto-loads Bow coatings.
skills.brief: Raises a Bowgun's reload rating by 2 steps, moving every ammo two steps toward the fast reload band, and a Bow loads a coating the moment you select it.

skills.name: Reload Speed +1
skills.desc:
Slightly speeds up Bowgun
reloading, and speeds up
Bow-coating loading.
skills.brief: Raises a Bowgun's reload rating by 1 step, which only speeds up ammo sitting right at a band edge, and a Bow loads coatings in 85% of the usual time.

skills.name: Reload Speed -1
skills.desc:
Slightly slows down Bowgun
reloading and Bow-coating
loading.
skills.brief: Lowers a Heavy or Light Bowgun's reload rating by 1 step, moving ammo toward slower reloads. On the Bow, loading a coating takes 110% of the usual time.

skills.name: Reload Speed -2
skills.desc:
Slows down Bowgun reloading
and Bow-coating loading.
skills.brief: Lowers a Heavy or Light Bowgun's reload rating by 2 steps, moving ammo toward slower reloads. On the Bow, loading a coating takes 120% of the usual time.

skills.name: Reload Speed -3
skills.desc:
Greatly slows down Bowgun
reloading and Bow-coating
loading.
skills.brief: Lowers a Heavy or Light Bowgun's reload rating by 3 steps, moving ammo toward slower reloads. On the Bow, loading a coating takes 130% of the usual time.

skills.name: Recoil Down +3
skills.desc: Greatly reduces Bowgun recoil.
skills.brief: Lowers a Heavy or Light Bowgun's recoil rating by 3 steps, moving every ammo three steps toward the lightest recoil.

skills.name: Recoil Down +2
skills.desc: Reduces Bowgun recoil.
skills.brief: Lowers a Heavy or Light Bowgun's recoil rating by 2 steps, moving every ammo two steps toward the lightest recoil. Stonefist Soul and Stonefist Soul X count as this skill.

skills.name: Recoil Down +1
skills.desc: Slightly reduces Bowgun recoil.
skills.brief: Lowers a Heavy or Light Bowgun's recoil rating by 1 step, moving every ammo one step toward the lightest recoil.

skills.name: Recoil Down -1
skills.desc: Slightly increases Bowgun recoil.
skills.brief: Raises a Heavy or Light Bowgun's recoil rating by 1 step, moving ammo one step toward the heaviest recoil; ammo not at the edge of a recoil band is unchanged.

skills.name: Recoil Down -2
skills.desc: Increases Bowgun recoil.
skills.brief: Raises a Heavy or Light Bowgun's recoil rating by 2 steps, moving every ammo two steps toward the heaviest recoil.

skills.name: Recoil Down -3
skills.desc: Greatly increases Bowgun recoil.
skills.brief: Raises a Heavy or Light Bowgun's recoil rating by 3 steps, moving every ammo three steps toward the heaviest recoil.

skills.name: Steadiness +2
skills.desc:
Greatly decreases Deviation
when firing.
skills.brief: Removes Bowgun deviation completely, so every gun fires straight. Paired with Felyne Temper it only lowers deviation by one level.

skills.name: Steadiness +1
skills.desc: Decreases Deviation when firing.
skills.brief: Lowers Bowgun deviation by one level: severe becomes mild and mild becomes none, still to the gun's own side. Felyne Temper cancels it out.

skills.name: Steadiness -1
skills.desc: Increases Deviation when firing.
skills.brief: Makes Bowgun deviation one level worse: a gun with none gets mild deviation to either side at random, and mild becomes severe.

skills.name: Steadiness -2
skills.desc:
Greatly increases Deviation when
firing.
skills.brief: Makes Bowgun deviation two levels worse, so every gun ends at severe; a gun with no deviation gets severe deviation to either side at random.

skills.name: Normal/Rapid Up
skills.desc:
Increases the power of Normal shots
(Normal S) and Rapid-type arrows.
skills.brief: Normal S Lv1 to Lv3, Light Bowgun charged shots and Rapid arrows deal x1.1 damage. On Bowgun shots it stacks with Felyne Sharpshooter for x1.21.

skills.name: Pierce/Pierce Up
skills.desc:
Increases the power of Pierce shots
(Pierce S) and Pierce-type arrows.
skills.brief: Every hit of Pierce S Lv1 to Lv3 and Pierce arrows deals x1.1 damage. Silver Bullet counts as this skill, so the two do not stack.

skills.name: Pellet/Spread Up
skills.desc:
Increases the power of Pellet shots
(Pellet S) and Spread-type arrows.
skills.brief: Pellet S (and the fragments Shrapnel S breaks into) deal x1.2 damage, and Spread arrows x1.3. Silver Bullet counts as this skill, so the two do not stack.

skills.name: Heavy/Heavy Up
skills.desc:
Increases the power of Heavy shots
(Heavy S) and Heavy arrows.
skills.brief: Heavy S Lv1 and Lv2 and Heavy arrows deal x1.1 damage. Silver Bullet does not cover Heavy shots, so this is the only way to boost them.

skills.name: Use Any Normal S
skills.desc:
Allows all levels of Normal shots
(Normal S) to be loaded.
skills.brief: Lets a Heavy or Light Bowgun load Normal S Lv1, Lv2 and Lv3 even if it normally can't, using the gun's own clip size for that ammo.

skills.name: Use Any Pierce S
skills.desc:
Allows all levels of Pierce shots
(Pierce S) to be loaded.
skills.brief: Lets a Heavy or Light Bowgun load Pierce S Lv1, Lv2 and Lv3 even if it normally can't, using the gun's own clip size for that ammo.

skills.name: Use Lv1 Pierce S
skills.desc:
Allows Lv1 Pierce shots (Pierce S)
to be loaded.
skills.brief: Lets a Heavy or Light Bowgun load Pierce S Lv1 even if it normally can't, using the gun's own clip size; Lv2 and Lv3 are not affected.

skills.name: Use Any Pellet S
skills.desc:
Allows all levels of Pellet shots
(Pellet S) to be loaded.
skills.brief: Lets a Heavy or Light Bowgun load Pellet S Lv1, Lv2 and Lv3 even if it normally can't, using the gun's own clip size for that ammo.

skills.name: Use Lv1 Pellet S
skills.desc:
Allows Lv1 Pellet shots (Pellet S)
to be loaded.
skills.brief: Lets a Heavy or Light Bowgun load Pellet S Lv1 even if it normally can't, using the gun's own clip size; Lv2 and Lv3 are not affected.

skills.name: Use Any Crag S
skills.desc:
Allows all levels of Crag shots
(Crag S) to be loaded.
skills.brief: Lets a Heavy or Light Bowgun load Crag S Lv1, Lv2 and Lv3 even if it normally can't, using the gun's own clip size for that ammo.

skills.name: Use Lv1 Crag S
skills.desc:
Allows Lv1 Crag shots (Crag S)
to be loaded.
skills.brief: Lets a Heavy or Light Bowgun load Crag S Lv1 even if it normally can't, using the gun's own clip size; Lv2 and Lv3 are not affected.

skills.name: Use Any Clust S
skills.desc:
Allows all levels of Cluster shots
(Clust S) to be loaded.
skills.brief: Lets a Heavy or Light Bowgun load Clust S Lv1, Lv2 and Lv3 even if it normally can't, using the gun's own clip size for that ammo.

skills.name: Use Lv1 Clust S
skills.desc:
Allows Lv1 Cluster shots (Clust S)
to be loaded.
skills.brief: Lets a Heavy or Light Bowgun load Clust S Lv1 even if it normally can't, using the gun's own clip size; Lv2 and Lv3 are not affected.

skills.name: Use Poison Coat
skills.desc:
Allows Poison coatings to be
set when equipped with a Bow.
skills.brief: Lets a Bow load the plain Poison Coating even if it normally can't; a Bow that already has it keeps its own version, boosted (+) included. No effect on Bowguns.

skills.name: Use Para Coat
skills.desc:
Allows Paralysis coatings to be
set when equipped with a Bow.
skills.brief: Lets a Bow load the plain Para Coating even if it normally can't; a Bow that already has it keeps its own version, boosted (+) included. No effect on Bowguns.

skills.name: Use Sleep Coat
skills.desc:
Allows Sleep coatings to be
set when equipped with a Bow.
skills.brief: Lets a Bow load the plain Sleep Coating even if it normally can't; a Bow that already has it keeps its own version, boosted (+) included. No effect on Bowguns.

skills.name: Power Phial (All)
skills.desc:
Allows Power coatings of all
levels to be set when wielding
a Bow.
skills.brief: Lets a Bow load the plain Power Coating Lv1 and Lv2 even if it normally can't; a Bow that already has them keeps its own versions, boosted (+) included.

skills.name: Power Phial (Lv1)
skills.desc:
Allows Lv1 Power coatings to
be set when wielding a Bow.
skills.brief: Lets a Bow load the plain Power Coating Lv1 even if it normally can't; Lv2 is not affected. A Bow that already has it keeps its own version.

skills.name: Element Phial (All)
skills.desc:
Allows Elemental coatings
of all levels to be set when
wielding a Bow.
skills.brief: Lets a Bow load the plain Elem Coating Lv1 and Lv2, but only if the Bow has an element; on a Bow without one it unlocks nothing.

skills.name: Element Phial (Lv1)
skills.desc:
Allows Elem Coating Lv1 to
be set when wielding a Bow.
skills.brief: Lets a Bow load the plain Elem Coating Lv1, but only if the Bow has an element; on a Bow without one it unlocks nothing. Lv2 is not affected.

skills.name: Use C.Range Coat
skills.desc:
Allows Close-range coatings to be
set when equipped with a Bow.
skills.brief: Lets a Bow load the plain C.Range Coating even if it normally can't; a Bow that already has it keeps its own version, boosted (+) included. No effect on Bowguns.

skills.name: Use Exhaust Coat
skills.desc:
Allows Exhaust coatings to be
set when equipped with a Bow.
skills.brief: Lets a Bow load the plain Exhaust Coating even if it normally can't; a Bow that already has it keeps its own version, boosted (+) included. No effect on Bowguns.

skills.name: Use Blast Coat
skills.desc:
Allows Blast coatings to be
set when equipped with a Bow.
skills.brief: Lets a Bow load the plain Blast Coating even if it normally can't; a Bow that already has it keeps its own version, boosted (+) included. No effect on Bowguns.

skills.name: Bonus Shot
skills.desc:
Allows one extra shot to be
fired while Rapid Firing.
skills.brief: Adds one shot to every Light Bowgun rapid fire, and the Alchemy Bullet bursts 3 instead of 2. Does nothing for the Heavy Bowgun or the Bow.

skills.name: Shot Booster
skills.desc:
Prolongs the time window
certain ammo and arrows
can hit at maximum power.
skills.brief: Stretches a shot's second damage stage: 0.13 s longer for Normal S, 0.2 s for Pierce S, while Heavy S reaches later stages sooner. Pellet, Crag, Clust and elemental shots are unchanged.

skills.name: Load Up
skills.desc:
Increases Bowgun and Gunlance
ammo, Bow charge levels, and
Charge Blade energy.
skills.brief: Adds 1 round to every Bowgun ammo clip, 1 Bow charge level (up to 4) and 1 Gunlance shell, and Charge Blade charges fill more phials (still under the phial cap).

skills.name: TrueShot Up
skills.desc:
Increases the power of Bowgun
Internal Ammo, and the Bow's
Arc Shot and Power Shot.
skills.brief: Bowgun internal ammo and the Bow's Arc Shot deal x1.2 damage, and the Bow's Power Shot x1.4. On the Bow it multiplies with the ammo Up skills.

skills.name: Ammo Saver
skills.desc:
Occasionally returns ammo or
phials to inventory when firing.
skills.brief: Each use of Bowgun ammo or a Bow coating has a 20% chance not to be used up. Despite the description, it does nothing for phials or shells.

skills.name: Critical Eye +3
skills.desc: Increases Affinity by 30%.
skills.brief: Adds +30% affinity on every weapon, counted right after the weapon's own affinity. Total affinity is capped at 100%.

skills.name: Critical Eye +2
skills.desc: Increases Affinity by 20%.
skills.brief: Adds +20% affinity on every weapon, counted right after the weapon's own affinity. Total affinity is capped at 100%.

skills.name: Critical Eye +1
skills.desc: Increases Affinity by 10%.
skills.brief: Adds +10% affinity on every weapon, counted right after the weapon's own affinity. Total affinity is capped at 100%.

skills.name: Critical Eye -1
skills.desc: Decreases Affinity by 5%.
skills.brief: Takes 5% off affinity; negative affinity turns some hits into weak hits (x0.75 damage). On weapons with a hidden negative share, the 5 is added to that share instead.

skills.name: Critical Eye -2
skills.desc: Decreases Affinity by 10%.
skills.brief: Takes 10% off affinity; negative affinity turns some hits into weak hits (x0.75 damage). On weapons with a hidden negative share, the 10 is added to that share instead.

skills.name: Critical Eye -3
skills.desc: Decreases Affinity by 15%.
skills.brief: Takes 15% off affinity; negative affinity turns some hits into weak hits (x0.75 damage). On weapons with a hidden negative share, the 15 is added to that share instead.

skills.name: Weakness Exploit
skills.desc:
Increases Affinity when striking
body parts your attacks are
highly effective against.
skills.brief: Gives +50% affinity to any hit on a body part with a hitzone value of 45 or more. It is checked hit by hit, so it never shows on the status screen.

skills.name: Repeat Offender
skills.desc:
Increases Affinity following
repeated attacks.
skills.brief: Landing hits gives +25% affinity (1 to 4 hits) or +30% (5 hits). Each hit restarts a 5 second timer; when it runs out the count drops to 0.

skills.name: Status Crit
skills.desc:
Increases abnormal status attack
potency (Paralysis, Poison, Sleep)
of your critical hits.
skills.brief: Critical hits build up poison, paralysis or sleep x1.2, the same on every weapon. Bitter Affinity's strong hits count as crits too.

skills.name: Elemental Crit
skills.desc:
Increases elemental damage
(Fire, Water, Thunder, Ice,
Dragon) of your critical hits.
skills.brief: Critical hits deal more element damage by weapon: x1.35 for Sword & Shield, Bow and Dual Blades, x1.3 for Bowguns, x1.2 for Great Sword, x1.25 for the rest.

skills.name: Critical Boost
skills.desc:
Increases the damage
of critical hits.
skills.brief: Critical hits deal x1.4 damage instead of x1.25. Weak hits stay at x0.75, and Bitter Affinity's x2.0 strong hits are unchanged.

skills.name: Bitter Affinity
skills.desc:
Negative Affinity attacks have a
chance to be strong Affinity attacks.
skills.brief: About 1 in 4 weak hits (x0.75) become strong hits worth x2.0. Only works with negative affinity or a weapon's hidden negative share; strong hits count as crits for Elemental Crit and Status Crit.

skills.name: Focus
skills.desc:
Speeds L.Sword/C.Blade/D.Blades/
S.Axe gauges, L.Bowgun Arts, and
G.Sword/Hammer/Bow charge attacks.
skills.brief: Long Sword, Charge Blade, Dual Blades and Switch Axe gauges fill about 20% faster, and Great Sword, Hammer, Bow and some Light Bowgun charges reach each level about 20% sooner.

skills.name: Distraction
skills.desc:
Slows L.Sword/D.Blades/S.Axe/C.Blade
gauges, L.Bowgun Hunter Arts, and
G.Sword/Hammer/Bow charge attacks.
skills.brief: Long Sword, Charge Blade, Dual Blades and Switch Axe gauges fill about 20% slower, and Great Sword, Hammer, Bow and some Light Bowgun charges take about 20% longer. Focus cancels it.

skills.name: Marathon Runner
skills.desc:
Slows down Stamina depletion
for actions which continuously
drain Stamina (such as dashing).
skills.brief: Halves the Stamina drained by sprinting and other continuous drains (x0.5), so a sprint lasts about twice as long. Felyne Escape Artist (sprint) or Felyne Supercat (the other drains) halve it again.

skills.name: Short Sprinter
skills.desc:
Speeds up Stamina depletion
for actions which continuously
drain Stamina (such as dashing).
skills.brief: Sprinting and other continuous drains use 20% more Stamina (x1.2), so a full sprint lasts about 83% as long. Marathon Runner cancels it.

skills.name: Constitution +2
skills.desc:
Greatly slows down Stamina
depletion when evading,
blocking, etc.
skills.brief: Halves the Stamina cost of evades and other one-off Stamina costs (x0.5): a roll that costs 25 Stamina costs 12.5.

skills.name: Constitution +1
skills.desc:
Slows down Stamina depletion
when evading, blocking, etc.
skills.brief: Cuts the Stamina cost of evades and other one-off costs to x0.75 (a 25 Stamina roll costs 18.75). With Bubbly Dance's bubble or Felyne Black Belt it reaches x0.5.

skills.name: Constitution -1
skills.desc:
Speeds up Stamina depletion
when evading, blocking, etc.
skills.brief: Evades and other one-off Stamina costs cost 20% more (x1.2): a 25 Stamina roll costs 30. Bubbly Dance's bubble or Felyne Black Belt brings it back to normal.

skills.name: Constitution -2
skills.desc:
Greatly speeds up Stamina
depletion when evading,
blocking, etc.
skills.brief: Evades and other one-off Stamina costs cost 35% more (x1.35): a 25 Stamina roll costs 33.75.

skills.name: Stam Recov Up
skills.desc: Increases Stamina recovery speed.
skills.brief: Doubles how fast Stamina refills (x2), at every refill rate, so an empty Stamina bar refills in half the time.

skills.name: Stam Recov Down
skills.desc: Decreases Stamina recovery speed.
skills.brief: Stamina refills at x0.75 speed, so an empty bar takes about 1.33 times as long. Stam Recov Up or a skill that grants it cancels it.

skills.name: Endurance Runner
skills.desc:
Stops Stamina depletion below
a certain point while dashing,
allowing for a longer dash.
skills.brief: Sprinting stops draining Stamina once you are at 25 or lower, so the sprint goes on and you keep 25 Stamina for an evade. Other continuous drains get the same floor.

skills.name: Evasion +2
skills.desc:
Extends the invulnerability
period when evading.
skills.brief: Doubles the basic roll's invulnerability from 0.2 s to 0.4 s, and lengthens other evades' windows too.

skills.name: Evasion +1
skills.desc:
Slightly extends the invulnerability
period when evading.
skills.brief: Lengthens the basic roll's invulnerability from 0.2 s to 0.33 s, and other evades' windows too. While Bubbly Dance's bubble is on, it works like Evasion +2.

skills.name: Evasion Down
skills.desc:
Reduces the invulnerability
period when evading.
skills.brief: Halves the basic roll's invulnerability from 0.2 s to 0.1 s, and shortens other evades' windows too. Bubbly Dance's bubble brings them back to normal.

skills.name: Evade Extender
skills.desc: Increases evade distance.
skills.brief: Evades on all fourteen weapons travel further: most get an extra push through their middle and end, while the start is unchanged (Hunting Horn evade movement x1.3).

skills.name: Bubbly Dance
skills.desc:
Evading covers you in bubbles,
improving your ability to dodge
enemy attacks.
skills.brief: After a few evades (4 rolls) you are bubbled for 90 seconds, gaining one extra level of Evasion and of Constitution. It also applies under a monster's bubbles.

skills.name: Guard +2
skills.desc:
Greatly increases the likelihood
of standing your ground when
blocking an attack.
skills.brief: Lowers the guard power of every attack you block by 20, for a lighter guard reaction, a smaller stamina cost and, on the Great Sword and Charge Blade, less sharpness lost.

skills.name: Guard +1
skills.desc:
Increases the likelihood of
standing your ground when
blocking an attack.
skills.brief: Lowers the guard power of every attack you block by 10, for a lighter guard reaction, a smaller stamina cost and, on the Great Sword and Charge Blade, less sharpness lost.

skills.name: Guard -1
skills.desc:
Decreases the likelihood of
standing your ground when
blocking an attack.
skills.brief: Raises the guard power of every attack you block by 10, for a heavier guard reaction, a bigger stamina cost and, on the Great Sword and Charge Blade, more sharpness lost.

skills.name: Guard Up
skills.desc:
Causes previously unblockable
attacks to become blockable.
skills.brief: Lets you block attacks marked as needing Guard Up, and blocked hits no longer give Defense Down. It does not widen your guard and never works on the Long Sword.

skills.name: Knockout King
skills.desc:
Makes it easier to
stun monsters.
skills.brief: Multiplies the stun (KO) value of your hits by 1.1, rounded down, so a hit needs a stun value of 10 or more to gain anything.

skills.name: Stamina Thief
skills.desc:
Increases certain attacks'
ability to Exhaust monsters.
skills.brief: Multiplies the exhaust value of your hits by 1.2, rounded down. Hits that have no exhaust value gain nothing.

skills.name: Horn Maestro
skills.desc:
Decreases the likelihood of Horn/Flute
items breaking, and increases the
effect time of Hunting Horn melodies.
skills.brief: Hunting Horn melody effects last longer (x1.17 to x2, depending on the effect), and item horns and flutes get a 50% chance not to break.

skills.name: Artillery Expert
skills.desc:
Boosts Ballistae, Crag shots, Impact
Phials, Shells, etc. Makes the
Heat Gauge more manageable.
skills.brief: Gunlance shells and Wyvern's Fire x1.2, Charge Blade phial bursts x1.35, Crag S, Cannon S and Wyvern S x1.3, Ballista shots x1.2; Wyvern's Fire Overheat drops from 120 to 90 s.

skills.name: Artillery Novice
skills.desc:
Slightly boosts Ballistae, Crag shots,
Impact Phials, Shells, etc. Makes
the Heat Gauge more manageable.
skills.brief: Gunlance shells and Wyvern's Fire x1.1, Charge Blade phial bursts x1.3, Crag S, Cannon S and Wyvern S x1.15, Ballista shots x1.1; Wyvern's Fire costs a third less heat.

skills.name: Partbreaker
skills.desc:
Makes it easier to break
or sever parts of monsters.
skills.brief: Damage to a monster's breakable parts is x1.3 while the part still has a break left, so a part needing 300 damage breaks at about 231.

skills.name: Bombardier
skills.desc:
Increases bomb damage, and
raises the Combination success
rate for all bombs to 100%.
skills.brief: Bomb damage x1.3 and Blast buildup x1.2, and Combinations for bombs, Gunpowder and Blast Coating always succeed.

skills.name: Latent Power +2
skills.desc:
Greatly empowers you for a limited
time when certain conditions are met.
skills.brief: Triggers after losing over 180 Health or after a 5 minute count: +50% affinity and x0.25 Stamina use for 150 s. Gives nothing while Challenger or Peak Performance is on.

skills.name: Latent Power +1
skills.desc:
Empowers you for a limited time
when certain conditions are met.
skills.brief: Triggers after losing over 180 Health or after a 5 minute count: +30% affinity and half Stamina use for 150 s. Gives nothing while Challenger or Peak Performance is on.

skills.name: Challenger +2
skills.desc:
Greatly increases Attack and
Affinity when a large monster
in the same area becomes angry.
skills.brief: +20 attack and +15% affinity once a large monster in your area has been enraged for 3 seconds. Peak Performance and Latent Power do not apply while it is on.

skills.name: Challenger +1
skills.desc:
Increases Attack and Affinity
when a large monster in the
same area becomes angry.
skills.brief: +10 attack and +10% affinity once a large monster in your area has been enraged for 3 seconds. Peak Performance and Latent Power do not apply while it is on.

skills.name: Peak Performance
skills.desc:
Increases Attack when your
Health Gauge is full.
skills.brief: +20 attack while your Health is full, added before multipliers such as Fortify. Any damage turns it off, and it gives nothing while Challenger's bonus is on.

skills.name: Trump Card
skills.desc:
Increases Hunter Art power
during fights with large monsters
when the chance arises.
skills.brief: For 60 s after a large monster in your area does certain actions, Hunter Art hits deal x1.2 and Arts started in that window get their own boost, such as a longer effect.

skills.name: Dragonheart
skills.desc:
When Health falls below 2/3,
you'll get Dragonblight but elemental
resistance and Attack increases.
skills.brief: At or below two thirds Health: attack x1.1 and every elemental resistance becomes 50, but you are always Dragonblighted. Dragon element weapons keep their element; others lose it.

skills.name: Adrenaline +2
skills.desc:
Greatly increases Attack and
Defense when Health is below
40% of the maximum amount.
skills.brief: At or below 40% Health, attack is multiplied by x1.3 and the low-Health defense bonus rises from +30 to +45.

skills.name: Adrenaline +1
skills.desc:
Greatly increases Defense
when Health is below 40%
of the maximum amount.
skills.brief: At or below 40% Health, the low-Health defense bonus rises from +30 to +45; attack is unchanged. It also stops Worrywart's penalties.

skills.name: Worrywart
skills.desc:
Decreases Defense boost and
Attack when Health is below
40% of maximum.
skills.brief: At or below 40% Health, attack drops to x0.7 and the low-Health defense bonus falls from +30 to +21. Adrenaline +1 or +2 overrides it.

skills.name: Fortify
skills.desc:
Increases your Attack
and Defense every time
you fall in battle.
skills.brief: After 1/2 faints, attack x1.1/x1.2 and defense x1.15/x1.3. The attack multiplier also boosts flat bonuses such as Attack Up.

skills.name: Resentment
skills.desc:
Increases Attack when your
Health Gauge is in the red.
skills.brief: +20 attack while you have red Health, until the red part recovers or you heal it. It is a flat bonus, so Fortify multiplies it.

skills.name: Resuscitate
skills.desc:
Increases Attack when you are
suffering from abnormal status.
skills.brief: +20 attack while you have an abnormal status, such as Poison, Sleep, paralysis, Stench, Bleeding, Defense Down or a blight. Several statuses at once still give +20.

skills.name: Guts
skills.desc:
Prevents fainting a single time if
struck with a lethal blow when a
certain amount of Health remains.
skills.brief: If you had at least 64 Health, a hit that would make you faint leaves you at 1 Health instead. Works once per life and returns each time you faint.

skills.name: Sneak
skills.desc:
Decreases the likelihood of
being targeted by monsters.
skills.brief: Your weight when a monster picks its target is x0.8, so you are less likely to be chosen. The attention your actions build up is not reduced.

skills.name: Taunt
skills.desc:
Increases the likelihood of
being targeted by monsters.
skills.brief: Your weight when a monster picks its target and the attention your actions build up are both x1.5. Does not stack with Felyne Provoker.

skills.name: Palico Rally
skills.desc:
Increases the Attack and Defense
of Palicoes.
skills.brief: Your Palicoes' attack (melee and ranged) and defense are multiplied by x1.1.

skills.name: Palico Cheer
skills.desc:
Allows "Fist Pump" gesture to call
back fainted/recovering Palicoes.
Cannot be used repeatedly.
skills.brief: Finishing the Fist Pump gesture calls back your fainted or recovering Palicoes; each one called back can't be called back again for 10 minutes.

skills.name: Mounting Master
skills.desc:
Makes it easier to mount and
successfully topple a monster.
skills.brief: Aerial attacks build up mounting x1.25 faster, and the struggle gauge fills x1.25 faster while you are mounted. All mount build-up boosts combined are capped at x1.4.

skills.name: Saddle Sore
skills.desc:
Makes it harder to mount
and successfully topple a
monster.
skills.brief: Aerial attacks build up mounting at only x0.9, and the struggle gauge fills at x0.9 while you are mounted. Not applied while Mounting Master or Snowbaron Soul X is active.

skills.name: Airborne
skills.desc:
Increases the damage caused by
Jumping Attacks.
skills.brief: Jumping attacks and other aerial attacks deal x1.1 physical damage (elemental damage is not raised) and build up mounting x1.1 faster.

skills.name: Composed
skills.desc:
Makes it easier to fill the Arts Gauge,
Valor Gauge, and Alchemy Gauge.
skills.brief: Every fill of the Hunter Arts gauges, the Alchemy gauge and the Valor gauge is x1.15, so each gauge fills about 13% sooner.

skills.name: Chance Seizer
skills.desc:
Fills the Arts Gauge, Valor Gauge
and Alchemy Gauge when
damage is received.
skills.brief: Health lost to some hits (counted up to 150) is added to your Hunter Arts gauges (x1.4 in Striker), and to the Valor gauge in Valor style or doubled to the Alchemy gauge in Alchemy style.

skills.name: Longer SP
skills.desc:
Extends the effect time of the SP State
triggered by SP Hunter Arts.
skills.brief: The SP state from every SP Hunter Art lasts 25% longer (x1.25).

skills.name: Autotracker
skills.desc:
Large monsters always display on
the Map, as if they were marked.
skills.brief: No Paintball is needed: large monsters are shown on the Map at all times. While it is active, Detect is skipped and Autotracker's display is used.

skills.name: Detect
skills.desc:
Increases the information
displayed on the Map when
large monsters are marked.
skills.brief: Marked large monsters show more on the Map, with a stronger version for the first 30 seconds of a quest, then a 2 in 3 chance of another 30-second window every 5 minutes.

skills.name: Capture Guru
skills.desc:
Grants knowledge of when a large
monster can be captured.
skills.brief: Shows on the Map when a large monster can be captured, so you don't need to guess or watch for limping before setting a trap. It activates at +10 Perception points.

skills.name: Outdoorsman
skills.desc:
Always shows the Map, even if
you don't have one. Easier to
fish and BBQ meat.
skills.brief: The Map is always shown even without the Map item, the BBQ Spit's done window grows from about 0.67 to 1 second, and fishing with Sushifish, Burst or Goldenfish Bait works as with Felyne Fisher.

skills.name: Pro Transporter
skills.desc:
Increases your speed while
transporting items and decreases
the likelihood of dropping them.

skills.name: Divine Blessing
skills.desc: Sometimes decreases damage taken.
skills.brief: Each hit that damages you has a 25% (1 in 4) chance to deal only x0.7 damage. With Felyne Defender (Hi) as well, the chance rises to 43.75%.

skills.name: Demonic Blessing
skills.desc: Sometimes increases damage taken.
skills.brief: Each hit that damages you has a 25% (1 in 4) chance to deal x1.3 damage, about 7.5% more damage taken on average. It never triggers while Divine Blessing is active.

skills.name: Hero's Talisman
skills.desc:
Negates the damage from minor
enemy attacks.
skills.brief: Any hit that would deal 5 damage or less after your defence does 0 instead. It is checked after Divine Blessing, so a hit that skill cuts to 5 or less is negated too.

skills.name: Recovery Up
skills.desc:
Increases the amount recovered
when recovering Health.
skills.brief: Every Health recovery is x1.25 (rounded down): a Potion heals 37 instead of 30, a Mega Potion 62 instead of 50. Also raises healing attacks and the Charge Blade's phial heal.

skills.name: Recovery Down
skills.desc:
Decreases the amount recovered
when recovering Health.
skills.brief: Every Health recovery is x0.75: a Potion heals 23 instead of 30, a Mega Potion 38 instead of 50. Not applied while Recovery Up or Benediction is active.

skills.name: Recovery Spd +2
skills.desc:
Greatly speeds recovery from
temporary damage (the red
portion of the Health Gauge).
skills.brief: Red Health comes back four times as fast: one tick every 0.5 seconds instead of every 2. A tick is normally 1 Health, 2 while an item's regeneration effect such as Immunizer is running.

skills.name: Recovery Spd +1
skills.desc:
Speeds recovery from temporary
damage (the red portion of the
Health Gauge).
skills.brief: Red Health comes back twice as fast: one tick every second instead of every 2 seconds. A tick never heals past the red part.

skills.name: Recovery Spd -1
skills.desc:
Slows recovery from temporary
damage (the red portion of the
Health Gauge).
skills.brief: Red Health comes back at half speed: one tick every 4 seconds instead of every 2.

skills.name: Recovery Spd -2
skills.desc:
Greatly slows recovery from
temporary damage (the red
portion of the Health Gauge).
skills.brief: Red Health comes back at a quarter of the speed: one tick every 8 seconds instead of every 2.

skills.name: Item Use Up
skills.desc:
Increases the effect time of
certain items.
skills.brief: Timed effects from items you use last 50% longer (x1.5): Might Seed and Dash Juice 4.5 min instead of 3, Cool and Hot Drinks 15 min instead of 10.

skills.name: Item Use Down
skills.desc:
Decreases the effect time of
certain items.
skills.brief: Timed effects from items you use last only x0.66 as long: Cool and Hot Drinks 6 min 36 s instead of 10 min. Not applied while Item Use Up or Elementality is active.

skills.name: Wide-Range +2
skills.desc:
Transfers the effects of
certain items to companions
in the same area.
skills.brief: Potions, Herbs, Might Seeds, Adamant Seeds, Antidotes, Nulberries and some other items also affect nearby hunters at full strength. The receiver's own healing skills apply.

skills.name: Wide-Range +1
skills.desc:
Transfers a portion of the
effects of certain items to
companions in the same area.
skills.brief: Certain items also affect nearby hunters: heals and stat boosts at half strength (a Potion heals 15, a Might Seed gives Attack +5), cures and Nulberry effects in full.

skills.name: Negate Hunger
skills.desc:
Negates maximum Stamina
depletion over time.
skills.brief: Your maximum Stamina no longer drops by 25 every 6 minutes. In a cold area without protection it still drops at the cold rate.

skills.name: Halve Hunger
skills.desc:
Halves the speed of maximum
Stamina depletion over time.
skills.brief: Your maximum Stamina drops by 25 every 12 minutes instead of every 6. The extra drain in a cold area without protection is not halved.

skills.name: Raise Hunger
skills.desc:
Speeds maximum Stamina
depletion over time.
skills.brief: Your maximum Stamina drops by 25 every 4 minutes instead of every 6 (x1.5). The extra drain in a cold area without protection is unchanged.

skills.name: Double Hunger
skills.desc:
Greatly speeds up maximum
Stamina depletion over time.
skills.brief: Your maximum Stamina drops by 25 every 3 minutes instead of every 6. The extra drain in a cold area without protection is unchanged.

skills.name: Scavenger
skills.desc:
Gives any item you eat or drink
the potential to also raise
your maximum Stamina.
skills.brief: Many consumables, such as Potions, Herbs, Seeds and fish, get a 1 in 3 chance to raise your maximum Stamina by 25. It also counts as Gourmand; maximum Stamina never goes above 150.

skills.name: Gourmand
skills.desc:
Increases the efficacy of meat
that raises maximum Stamina.
skills.brief: Food that raises maximum Stamina, such as meats, adds 25 more on top of its normal amount. Maximum Stamina never goes above 150.

skills.name: Speed Eating +2
skills.desc:
Increases meat-eating and
item-consuming speed.
skills.brief: Using items plays x1.7 faster (about 59% of the normal time) and eating meat x1.8 faster, saving about 1 second per steak.

skills.name: Speed Eating +1
skills.desc: Increases meat-eating speed.
skills.brief: Eating meat plays x1.8 faster, saving about 1 second. Other items are not sped up.

skills.name: Slow Eater
skills.desc: Decreases meat-eating speed.
skills.brief: Eating meat takes about 0.67 seconds longer, as the chewing part repeats up to 4 more times. Not applied while Speed Eating is active.

skills.name: Rationer
skills.desc:
Sometimes allows you to
reuse items after you eat
and drink them.
skills.brief: Each item you eat or drink has a 25% chance not to be used up, with a message when it is saved. Does not work on Glutton Tuna, Gastronome Tuna, the four oils or Cleanser.

skills.name: Meat Lover
skills.desc:
Raw Meat becomes edible. Rare
and Well-done Steaks temporarily
grant unlimited Stamina.
skills.brief: Raw Meat becomes usable, and Rare Steak, Well-done Steak, Chilled Meat and Hot Meat stop Stamina from draining for 60 seconds. Mosswine Jerky raises maximum Stamina by 25.

skills.name: Mushromancer
skills.desc:
Allows the consumption of
mushrooms which grant
certain benefits as a result.
skills.brief: Lets you eat mushrooms, each giving an item's effect: Blue Mushroom heals 30 and cures, Nitroshroom acts as Demondrug, Mopeshroom as Dash Juice, Super Mushroom heals 50.

skills.name: Pro Herbology
skills.desc:
Increases the amount of Health
recovered from eating Herbs even
more than the Herbology skill.
skills.brief: A Herb heals 50 instead of 20, and a Herb shared to you through Wide-Range heals x2.5. Herbology is ignored while it is active.

skills.name: Herbology
skills.desc:
Increases the amount of Health
recovered from eating Herbs.
skills.brief: A Herb heals 30 instead of 20, and a Herb shared to you through Wide-Range heals x1.5. Not used while Pro Herbology is active.

skills.name: Combination +45%
skills.desc:
Increases your Combination
success rate by 45%.
skills.brief: Adds 45 points to the success rate of combinations, so any recipe at 55% or more always succeeds. Stacks with Felyne Combiner and the Combo Books, capped at 100%.

skills.name: Combination +20%
skills.desc:
Increases your Combination
success rate by 20%.
skills.brief: Adds 20 points to the success rate of combinations: a 65% recipe becomes 85%. Stacks with Felyne Combiner and the Combo Books, capped at 100%.

skills.name: Combination -10%
skills.desc:
Decreases your Combination
success rate by 10%.
skills.brief: Takes 10 points off the success rate of combinations: a 65% recipe becomes 55%. Combinations another skill guarantees, such as with Trap Master or Bombardier, are unaffected.

skills.name: Combination -20%
skills.desc:
Decreases your Combination
success rate by 20%.
skills.brief: Takes 20 points off the success rate of combinations: a 65% recipe becomes 45%. Combinations another skill guarantees, such as with Trap Master or Bombardier, are unaffected.

skills.name: Combination Pro
skills.desc:
Guarantees maximum results with
Combinations that can produce
more than one item at a time.
skills.brief: Combinations that can produce more than one item always give the maximum number instead of a random amount. It does not change the chance of success.

skills.name: Trap Master
skills.desc:
Guarantees trap Combinations
will succeed, and speeds up
trap- and bomb-setting time.
skills.brief: Combinations for Poisoned Meat, Tinged Meat, Drugged Meat, Net, Pitfall Trap and Shock Trap always succeed, and setting traps and bombs plays at double speed.

skills.name: Gathering +2
skills.desc:
Often raises the number of
times items can be gathered
at Gathering Points.
skills.brief: Gathering Points last longer: after the guaranteed gathers, each further gather has a 3 in 32 chance to empty the point instead of 7 in 32. Felyne Gatherer lowers it further.

skills.name: Gathering +1
skills.desc:
Sometimes raises the number
of times items can be gathered
at Gathering Points.
skills.brief: Gathering Points last longer: after the guaranteed gathers, each further gather has a 5 in 32 chance to empty the point instead of 7 in 32. Felyne Gatherer lowers it further.

skills.name: Gathering -1
skills.desc:
Sometimes lowers the number
of times items can be gathered
at Gathering Points.
skills.brief: Gathering Points run out sooner: after the guaranteed gathers, each further gather has an 11 in 32 chance to empty the point instead of 7 in 32. Does nothing while Pack Rat is active.

skills.name: Honey Hunter
skills.desc:
Allows you to gather two Honeys
or Royal Honeys at once.
skills.brief: Every time you gather Honey or Royal Honey you get one extra. It is not a chance: it always happens.

skills.name: Charm Chaser
skills.desc:
Allows you to mine two Charms
at once... Maybe.
skills.brief: Mining a Mystery, Shining, Timeworn or Enduring Charm has a 30% chance to give a second charm.

skills.name: Charm Collector
skills.desc:
Allows you to mine two Charms
at once... Maaaybe.
skills.brief: Mining a Mystery, Shining, Timeworn or Enduring Charm has a 20% chance to give a second charm. Charm Chaser (+15 Charmer points) raises it to 30%.

skills.name: Divine Whim
skills.desc:
Greatly decreases the likelihood of
Pickaxes, Bug Nets, Boomerangs,
Flutes, and Horns breaking.
skills.brief: Whenever a Pickaxe, Bug Net, Flute or Boomerang would break, it is saved half the time, halving the break chance (an Iron Pickaxe goes from 10% to 5%).

skills.name: Spirit's Whim
skills.desc:
Decreases the likelihood of
Pickaxes, Bug Nets, Boomerangs,
Flutes, and Horns breaking.
skills.brief: A Pickaxe or Bug Net that would break is saved 1 time in 4 (break chance x3/4), and a Flute or Boomerang 1 time in 3 (x2/3).

skills.name: Spectre's Whim
skills.desc:
Increases the likelihood of
Pickaxes, Bug Nets, Boomerang,
Flutes, and Horns breaking.
skills.brief: On 1 use in 4, a tool's break odds are roughly doubled, so an Iron Pickaxe breaks 11.7% of the time instead of 10%.

skills.name: Devil's Whim
skills.desc:
Greatly increases the likelihood of
Pickaxes, Bug Nets, Boomerangs,
Flutes, and Horns breaking.
skills.brief: On half of all uses, a tool's break odds are roughly doubled, so an Iron Pickaxe breaks 13.3% of the time instead of 10%.

skills.name: Miraculous Luck
skills.desc:
Very often increases the number
of Reward Items received at
the end of a Quest.
skills.brief: Each roll for an extra quest reward succeeds 31 times in 32 instead of 22 in 32, so going from 3 to 8 rewards happens 85% of the time instead of 15%.

skills.name: Great Luck
skills.desc:
Often increases the number
of Reward Items received at
the end of a Quest.
skills.brief: Each roll for an extra quest reward succeeds 28 times in 32 instead of 22 in 32, so going from 3 to 8 rewards happens 51% of the time instead of 15%.

skills.name: Good Luck
skills.desc:
Sometimes increases the number
of Reward Items received at
the end of a Quest.
skills.brief: Each roll for an extra quest reward succeeds 25 times in 32 instead of 22 in 32, so going from 3 to 8 rewards happens 29% of the time instead of 15%.

skills.name: Bad Luck
skills.desc:
Sometimes decreases the number
of Reward Items received at
the end of a Quest.
skills.brief: Each roll for an extra quest reward succeeds only 16 times in 32 (50%) instead of 22 in 32. Does nothing while Bounty Hunter is active.

skills.name: Horrible Luck
skills.desc:
Often decreases the number
of Reward Items received at
the end of a Quest.
skills.brief: Each roll for an extra quest reward succeeds only 8 times in 32 (25%) instead of 22 in 32. Does nothing while Bounty Hunter is active.

skills.name: Carving Celebrity
skills.desc:
Increases the number of carving
chances by one and prevents
knockbacks while carving.
skills.brief: You always get one extra carve on monsters, and attacks can't knock you back while you carve. Felyne Carver adds nothing on top.

skills.name: Carving Pro
skills.desc:
Prevents knockbacks from
attacks while carving.
skills.brief: Attacks can't knock you back while you carve, so a carve is not interrupted. It activates at +10 Carving points; +15 gives Carving Celebrity, which also adds an extra carve.

skills.name: Capture Master
skills.desc:
Often increases the number
of Reward Items received for
captures.
skills.brief: Each captured monster gives one more capture reward: 4 rewards 68.75% of the time, otherwise 3 (3.69 on average instead of 2.69).

skills.name: Capture Expert
skills.desc:
Sometimes increases the number
of Reward Items received for
captures.
skills.brief: Each captured monster always gives 3 capture rewards, removing the 2-reward result that happens 5 times in 16 without the skill.

skills.name: Soul of Bherna
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Fire
Res +15" and "Halve Hunger."
skills.brief: Gives Fire Res +15 and Halve Hunger together: fire resistance +15, and your maximum Stamina drains at half speed over time. With Fire Res +20 you get +20 instead, not both.

skills.name: Soul of Kokoto
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Spirit's
Whim" and "Thunder Res +15."
skills.brief: Gives Spirit's Whim and Thunder Res +15: a Pickaxe or Bug Net that would break is saved 1 time in 4, a Flute or Boomerang 1 in 3, and thunder resistance is +15. Works with Divine Whim.

skills.name: Soul of Pokke
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Ice Res +15" and "Gourmand."
skills.brief: Gives Ice Res +15 and Gourmand: ice resistance +15, and meats that raise your maximum Stamina give +25 more.

skills.name: Soul of Yukumo
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Honey
Hunter" and "Water Res +15."
skills.brief: Gives Honey Hunter and Water Res +15: one extra Honey or Royal Honey every time you gather one, and water resistance +15.

skills.name: Soaratorium Soul
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Bio
Researcher" and "Dragon Res +15".
skills.brief: Gives Bio Researcher and Dragon Res +15: prevents Stench and Blastblight, Dung Bomb Combinations always succeed, dung-type effects are stronger, and dragon resistance is +15.

skills.name: Flying Pub Soul
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Knockout
King" and "Horn Maestro".
skills.brief: Gives Knockout King (the stun value of your hits is x1.1) and Horn Maestro (a Flute or horn item that would break is saved half the time, and Hunting Horn songs last longer).

skills.name: Redhelm Soul
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Focus"
and "Resentment."
skills.brief: Counts as Focus and Resentment: some weapons' gauges fill x1.2 and charge levels come x1.25 faster, and you get +20 attack while there is red health on your gauge.

skills.name: Snowbaron Soul
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Evade
Extender" and "Stam Recov Up."
skills.brief: Counts as Evade Extender and Stam Recov Up: evades travel further with every weapon, and Stamina regenerates x2.

skills.name: Stonefist Soul
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Razor
Sharp," "Recoil Down +2," and
"Divine Blessing."
skills.brief: Counts as Razor Sharp, Recoil Down +2 and Divine Blessing: sharpness loss halved, Bowgun recoil 2 grades lower, and a 25% chance that a hit's damage is cut to x0.7.

skills.name: Drilltusk Soul
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Adrenaline +2" and "Scavenger."
skills.brief: Counts as Adrenaline +2 and Scavenger: at 40% health or less, attack x1.3 and defense +45; many consumables get a 1 in 3 chance of +25 max Stamina, and meat gives +25 more.

skills.name: Dreadqueen Soul
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Status
Atk +2" and "Wide-Range +2."
skills.brief: Counts as Status Atk +2 and Wide-Range +2: poison, paralysis and sleep build-up x1.2 then +1 (not blast), and items such as Potions and Seeds are shared with nearby hunters at full strength.

skills.name: Crystalbeard Soul
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Charm
Chaser" and "Negate Hunger."
skills.brief: Counts as Charm Chaser and Negate Hunger: a 30% chance of a second charm when you get a Mystery, Shining, Timeworn or Enduring Charm, and max Stamina no longer drops by 25 every 6 minutes.

skills.name: Silverwind Soul
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Evasion +2" and "Critical Eye +3."
skills.brief: Counts as Evasion +2 and Critical Eye +3: longer invulnerability on evades (a standard roll goes from 0.2 s to 0.4 s) and +30% affinity.

skills.name: Deadeye Soul
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Negate
Stun" and "Challenger +2."
skills.brief: Counts as Negate Stun and Challenger +2: you are never stunned, and once a large monster in your area has been enraged for 3 s you get +20 attack and +15% affinity.

skills.name: Dreadking Soul
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Attack
Up (L)" and "Windproof (Hi)."
skills.brief: Counts as Attack Up (L) and Windproof (Hi): +20 attack added before every multiplier, and small and large wind pressure is removed.

skills.name: Thunderlord Soul
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Latent
Power +2" and "Constitution +2."
skills.brief: Counts as Latent Power +2 (once triggered: +50% affinity and Stamina costs x0.25 for 2.5 minutes) and Constitution +2 (evades and guards cost x0.5 Stamina).

skills.name: Grimclaw Soul
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "HG
Earplugs" and "Speed Eating +2."
skills.brief: Counts as HG Earplugs and Speed Eating +2: blocks both large and small roars, items are used x1.7 faster and meat is eaten x1.8 faster.

skills.name: Hellblade Soul
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Sharpness +2," "Shot Booster,"
and "Speed Sharpening."
skills.brief: Counts as Sharpness +2 (up to +50 maximum sharpness), Shot Booster (one power stage lasts longer in flight; not Pellet, Crag or Cluster S) and Speed Sharpening (a whetstone takes one stroke).

skills.name: Nightcloak Soul
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "HG Earplugs,"
"Reload Speed +3," and "Steady Hand."
skills.brief: Counts as HG Earplugs, Reload Speed +3 and Steady Hand: blocks large and small roars, Bowguns reload 3 grades faster, hits that would bounce land instead, and sharpness loss is halved.

skills.name: Rustrazor Soul
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Guard +2"
and "Quick Sheath."
skills.brief: Counts as Guard +2 and Quick Sheath: the guard power of every blocked attack is cut by 20 (smaller reactions, less Stamina), and sheathing is x1.4 faster with every weapon.

skills.name: Soulseer Soul
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Critical Eye +3" and "Challenger +1."
skills.brief: Counts as Critical Eye +3 and Challenger +1: +30% affinity, plus +10 attack and +10% affinity once a large monster in your area has been enraged for 3 s.

skills.name: Boltreaver Soul
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Critical Boost,"
"Bonus Shot," and "Sharpness +1."
skills.brief: Counts as Critical Boost, Bonus Shot and Sharpness +1: critical hits deal x1.4 instead of x1.25, Light Bowgun rapid fire fires one more shot, and +1 sharpness level.

skills.name: Elderfrost Soul
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Marathon
Runner," "Bludgeoner," and
"Normal/Rapid Up."
skills.brief: Counts as Marathon Runner, Bludgeoner and Normal/Rapid Up: sprinting drains Stamina x0.5, blademaster attack x1.1 to x1.2 at green or lower sharpness, and Normal S and Rapid arrows deal x1.1.

skills.name: Bloodbath Soul
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Attack Up (L)" and "Evasion +2."
skills.brief: Counts as Attack Up (L) and Evasion +2: +20 attack added before every multiplier, and longer invulnerability on evades (a standard roll goes from 0.2 s to 0.4 s).

skills.name: Redhelm Soul X
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Resentment,"
"Focus," and "Marathon Runner."
skills.brief: Counts as Resentment, Focus and Marathon Runner: +20 attack while you have red health, some weapons' gauges fill x1.2 and charge levels come x1.25 faster, and sprinting drains Stamina x0.5.

skills.name: Snowbaron Soul X
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Evade
Extender," "Mounting Master," and
"Stam Recov Up."
skills.brief: Counts as Evade Extender, Mounting Master and Stam Recov Up: evades travel further, mount build-up from aerial hits is x1.25, and Stamina regenerates x2.

skills.name: Stonefist Soul X
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Razor Sharp,"
"Recoil Down +2," "Divine Blessing,"
and "Constitution +1."
skills.brief: Counts as Razor Sharp, Recoil Down +2, Divine Blessing and Constitution +1: sharpness loss halved, recoil 2 grades lower, 25% chance a hit is cut to x0.7, evades cost x0.75 Stamina.

skills.name: Drilltusk Soul X
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Adrenaline +2," "Scavenger,"
and "Artillery Expert."
skills.brief: Counts as Adrenaline +2, Scavenger and Artillery Expert: attack x1.3 at 40% health or less, many consumables may raise max Stamina, Gunlance shells x1.2 and Charge Blade phial bursts x1.35.

skills.name: D.queen Soul X
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Status Atk +2," "Wide-Range +2,"
and "Pro Herbology."
skills.brief: Counts as Status Atk +2, Wide-Range +2 and Pro Herbology: poison, paralysis and sleep build-up x1.2 then +1, items shared with nearby hunters at full strength, and a Herb heals 50.

skills.name: C.beard Soul X
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Charm Chaser," "Hero's Talisman,"
and "Negate Hunger."
skills.brief: Counts as Charm Chaser, Hero's Talisman and Negate Hunger: a 30% chance of a second charm, hits of 5 damage or less deal 0, and max Stamina no longer drops by 25 every 6 minutes.

skills.name: Silverwind Soul X
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Evasion +2,"
"Critical Eye +3," and "Sneak."
skills.brief: Counts as Evasion +2, Critical Eye +3 and Sneak: longer invulnerability on evades, +30% affinity, and monsters favour you less as a target (x0.8). It also cancels Taunt.

skills.name: Deadeye Soul X
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Negate Stun,"
"Challenger +2," and "Fortify."
skills.brief: Counts as Negate Stun, Challenger +2 and Fortify: never stunned, +20 attack and +15% affinity after a large monster is enraged for 3 s, and attack x1.1/x1.2 after one/two faints.

skills.name: Dreadking Soul X
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Windproof (Hi)," "Attack Up (L),"
and "Adrenaline +1."
skills.brief: Counts as Windproof (Hi), Attack Up (L) and Adrenaline +1: small and large wind pressure removed, +20 attack, and defense +45 instead of +30 at 40% health or less.

skills.name: Thunderlord Soul X
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Latent Power +2," "Constitution +2,"
and "Focus."
skills.brief: Counts as Latent Power +2, Constitution +2 and Focus: +50% affinity and x0.25 Stamina costs for 2.5 minutes once triggered, evades cost x0.5 Stamina, and gauges and charges build faster.

skills.name: Grimclaw Soul X
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Speed Eating +2," "HG Earplugs,"
and "Longer SP."
skills.brief: Counts as Speed Eating +2, HG Earplugs and Longer SP: items used x1.7 faster and meat x1.8, both large and small roars blocked, and the SP state lasts x1.25 as long.

skills.name: Hellblade Soul X
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Sharpness +2," "Bombardier,"
"Shot Booster," and "Speed Sharpening."
skills.brief: Counts as Sharpness +2 (+50 max sharpness), Bombardier (blast x1.2, bomb Combinations always succeed), Shot Booster and Speed Sharpening (whetstone in one stroke). Doesn't stack with those skills.

skills.name: Nightcloak Soul X
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "HG Earplugs,"
"Reload Speed +3," "Steady Hand,"
and "Trap Master."
skills.brief: Counts as HG Earplugs (blocks large and small roars), Reload Speed +3, Steady Hand (no bounces, half sharpness loss) and Trap Master (trap Combinations always succeed). Doesn't stack with those skills.

skills.name: Rustrazor Soul X
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Guard +2,"
"Quick Sheath," and "Bladescale Hone."
skills.brief: Counts as Guard +2 (guard power -20), Quick Sheath (x1.4 sheathing) and Bladescale Hone (evading with the weapon drawn restores sharpness). Doesn't stack with those skills.

skills.name: Soulseer Soul X
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Critical Eye +3" and "Challenger +2."
skills.brief: Counts as Critical Eye +3 (+30% affinity) and Challenger +2 (+20 attack, +15% affinity once a large monster in your area has been enraged for 3 s), so +45% affinity when enraged. Doesn't stack with those skills.

skills.name: Boltreaver Soul X
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Critical Boost,"
"Bonus Shot," "Sharpness +1,"
and "Chance Seizer."
skills.brief: Counts as Critical Boost (crits x1.4), Bonus Shot, Sharpness +1 and Chance Seizer (Health lost from some hits fills your Arts, Valor and Alchemy gauges). Doesn't stack with those skills.

skills.name: Elderfrost Soul X
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Marathon Runner," "Bludgeoner,"
"Normal/Rapid Up," and "Attack Up (M)."
skills.brief: Counts as Marathon Runner, Bludgeoner, Normal/Rapid Up (x1.1) and Attack Up (M) (+15 attack). An Attack Up (L) source replaces the +15 rather than adding to it.

skills.name: Bloodbath Soul X
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Attack Up (L),"
"Evasion +2," and "Composed."
skills.brief: Counts as Attack Up (L) (+20 attack), Evasion +2 (roll invulnerability 0.2 s to 0.4 s) and Composed (Arts, Alchemy and Valor gauges fill x1.15). Doesn't stack with those skills.

skills.name: Pro Dirty Fencer
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Fortify,"
"Marathon Runner," and "Stamina
Thief."
skills.brief: Fortify (attack x1.1/x1.2, defense x1.15/x1.3 after 1/2+ faints), Marathon Runner (Stamina costs and drains halved) and Stamina Thief (exhaust x1.2). No extra Fortify from other sources.

skills.name: Steady Hand
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Mind's Eye" and "Razor Sharp."
skills.brief: Hits that would bounce land instead, sharpness loss is halved, and Blind Eye's forced bounces are switched off.

skills.name: Alloy Stomach
