skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Speed Eating +2," "Meat Lover,"
and "Mushromancer."
skills.brief: Speed Eating +2 (items x1.7, meat x1.8 speed), Meat Lover (Raw Meat usable, Rare and Well-done Steaks stop Stamina drain for 60 seconds) and Mushromancer (mushrooms give item effects) in one.

skills.name: Explosive Trapper
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Bombardier" and "Trap Master."
skills.brief: Bombardier (bomb explosions x1.3, Blast x1.2) plus Trap Master: bomb and trap Combinations always succeed, and five item-placing actions run at double speed.

skills.name: Crushing Blow
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Stamina Thief" and "Knockout King."
skills.brief: Your hits build x1.1 stun (KO) and x1.2 exhaust. It only helps attacks that already carry stun or exhaust, such as impact attacks.

skills.name: Benediction
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Recovery Up" and "Divine Blessing."
skills.brief: Recovery Up (all Health recovery x1.25) plus Divine Blessing (25% chance a hit deals x0.7 damage). It also stops Demonic Blessing from ever triggering.

skills.name: Clandestine
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Load Up,"
"Combination +20%," and "Sneak."
skills.brief: Load Up (+1 ammo, Bow charge level or Gunlance shell), Combination +20% and Sneak (monsters weigh you x0.8 when choosing a target). It cancels Taunt.

skills.name: Honed Blade
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Sharpness +1" and "Attack Up (L)."
skills.brief: +20 attack (as Attack Up (L)) and +1 sharpness step (as Sharpness +1). Doesn't stack with Attack Up (L) itself.

skills.name: Silver Bullet
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Normal/Rapid Up," "Pierce/Pierce Up,"
and "Pellet/Spread Up."
skills.brief: Normal S, Rapid arrows, Pierce S and Pierce arrows x1.1; Pellet S x1.2 and Spread arrows x1.3. Heavy S and Heavy arrows are not included, and it adds nothing to the single skills it contains.

skills.name: Wellness
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Negate Poison," "Negate Paralysis,"
"Negate Sleep," and "Negate Stun."
skills.brief: You can't be poisoned, paralyzed, put to sleep or stunned, and an existing poison does no damage.

skills.name: Wrath Awoken
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Adrenaline +2" and "Guts."
skills.brief: Attack x1.3 at 40% Health or less, plus Guts: some hits that would make you faint leave you at 1 Health once, if you had 64 or more. Worrywart has no effect.

skills.name: Acrobat
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Constitution +1" and "Evasion +1."
skills.brief: One-off Stamina costs such as rolls x0.75, and the roll's invulnerability goes from 0.2 s to 0.33 s. Adds nothing if you already have Evasion +2 and Constitution +2.

skills.name: Sheath Control
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Punishing Draw" and "Quick Sheath."
skills.brief: Draw attacks deal their stun value and exhaust, +5 attack on Blademaster weapons except the Hammer and Hunting Horn, and sheathing is x1.4 faster on every weapon.

skills.name: Iron Wall
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Defense Up (M)" and "Iron Skin."
skills.brief: Defense x1.03 then +20 (as Defense Up (M)), and attacks that would lower your Defense do nothing (as Iron Skin).

skills.name: Ruthlessness
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Critical Eye +2" and
"Weakness Exploit."
skills.brief: +20% affinity, plus +50% affinity on hits to weak hitzones (value 45 or more). With 0% weapon affinity, weak-spot hits roll at 70%.

skills.name: Shield Bearer
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Guard Up"
and "Stam Recov Up."
skills.brief: The Great Sword and shield weapons can block attacks that need Guard Up, blocked hits can't lower your Defense, and Stamina recovers x2.

skills.name: Fleet Feet
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Peak Performance" and
"Evade Extender."
skills.brief: Every evade travels further, and +20 attack while your Health is full (not while Challenger's state is up).

skills.name: Elementality
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Element Atk Up" and "Item Use Up."
skills.brief: All five elements x1.1 on your weapon, shots and arrows, plus Item Use Up's longer item effects. All element multipliers together are capped at x1.2.

skills.name: Pack Rat
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Charm Chaser" and "Gathering +1."
skills.brief: 30% chance of an extra charm when you get a Mystery, Shining, Timeworn or Enduring Charm, and a gathering point is used up less often (5 in 32 per gather instead of 7 in 32).

skills.name: Bounty Hunter
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Great Luck" and "Capture Expert."
skills.brief: Great Luck (each extra-reward roll succeeds 28 in 32 instead of 22 in 32) and Capture Expert (every capture gives exactly 3 capture rewards).

skills.name: Hazefur Talisman
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Polar Hunter,"
"Windproof (Hi)," and "Negate Bind."
skills.brief: Polar Hunter (+15 attack, +20 defence and no Stamina drain in cold areas), Windproof (Hi) (small and large wind pressure negated) and Negate Bind (binds such as Snowman don't take hold).

skills.name: Pyroscale Talisman
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of
"Negate Poison," "Anti-Theft,"
and "Autotracker."
skills.brief: Negate Poison (Deadly Poison lands only as ordinary poison), Anti-Theft (monsters can't steal your items) and Autotracker (large monsters always shown on the map).

skills.name: Steelshell Talisman
skills.desc:
Combines the effects of "Tropic Hunter,"
"Fire Res +20," and "Bio Researcher."
skills.brief: Tropic Hunter (+15 attack, +20 defence and no heat damage in hot areas), Fire Res +20, and Bio Researcher (prevents Stench and Blastblight; Dung Bomb Combinations always succeed).

skills.name: Skill +2
skills.desc:
Adds a further two Skill Points to
all skills with points invested.
skills.brief: Adds +2 points to every skill tree you already have points in, so +8 reaches +10. Negative trees rise too (-10 to -8), switching their skill off.

skills.name: Double Talisman
skills.desc:
Doubles the amount of Skill Points
gained through talismans.
skills.brief: Your talisman's skill points, including its decorations, count twice; negative points double too. Does nothing without a talisman.
